question: What diagram is drawn after the aśoka tree?
premises: aśokatarum ālikhya states drawing aśoka tree
trikoṇaṃ maṇḍalaṃ likhet states drawing three-cornered diagram
inference: After drawing the aśoka tree, one draws a three-cornered diagram.
